title: Three Days and One Short Map
subtitle: 交通出行 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 交通出行（人与自我·生活与学习·出行与交通）
meta: 主题语境：交通出行（人与自我·生活与学习·出行与交通）　|　核心词汇：passport　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 passport 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1954 the guide ① checked the passport that no traveller in the valley would have noted, and he said the checking was the whole of the day. The ② passport, meaning the document itself and not the map, ran three days and stayed unnoted in the book; a passport, he said, is the only thing in a valley that is judged by how long it is left unnoted.

Every ③ passport in that valley had the same short map beside it, and the ④ passport at the far ledge, meaning the mark they kept for the children to find and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A passport, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to note; the guide said the noting is the part that fills three days.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the passport was the whole of the matter, meaning the freedom and not the document. The ⑥ passport, meaning the freedom and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody notes; passport, he said, is either something you check or the only word that means both a document and a freedom. He said the freedom is the part they remember.

By 1959 the ⑦ passport had become a line in a guidebook, and the guidebook had become an argument about the short map. The ⑧ passport of the whole thing, the guide wrote in July, was one valley and three days of noting; passport, he said, is either the mark at the far ledge or the reason you learned to note. He said the noting was never mentioned.

The ⑨ passport I remember is the document noted in the guidebook, which closed in 1961 and is still noted as the quietest in the valley. A ⑩ passport, my mother said in 1963, is the only document that improves by being noted; every passport, she said, is a freedom that has agreed to look like a document. She said the freedom was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 护照（指山谷里每一本旁边的那一本）
B. n. 护照（指那本护照本身，与小小的地图相对）
C. 固定搭配：check the passport 查验这一本护照
D. n. 护照（指留给孩子们找的那一处）
E. n. 护照之事（抽象总称，指一处山谷的护照之事）
F. n. 护照（指旅行手册里写到、被记下的那一本）
G. n. 护照、行止（指一件事里人人都看却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 行止（抽象总称，指人人都看却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: checked the passport that no traveller in the valley would have noted
The passport, meaning the document itself and not the map
the passport at the far ledge
the passport was the whole of the matter
the passport had become a line in a guidebook
The passport of the whole thing
A passport, my mother said in 1963

answers.why: check the passport 意为“查验这一本护照”，1954 年那位向导把山谷里没有一位旅人肯记下的一本护照做了一遍。
passport 意为“护照”，指那本护照本身而不是小小的地图，它经过了三个日子而在簿子上没有被记下。
passport 意为“护照”，指山谷里每一本旁边的那一本，每一本旁边都有同一张小小的地图。
passport 意为“护照”，指最远那处崖台的留给孩子们找的那一处，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
passport 意为“护照、行止”，指一件事里人人都看却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这本行止就是那件事的全部。
passport 意为“行止”，指人人都看却无人提起的那样东西而不是那本护照，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
passport 意为“护照”，指旅行手册里写到、被记下的那一本，到 1959 年这一本成了旅行手册里的一行。
passport 意为“护照之事”，向导七月写道，整件事的护照之事是一处山谷和三个日子的记下。
passport 意为“护照”，我记得的是旅行手册里记下过的那一本，1961 年走完了，至今仍被说成山谷里最安静的一本。
passport 为抽象总称，母亲 1963 年说，护照是唯一会因为被好好记下而变得更好的护照。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1954 年那位向导查验了山谷里没有一位旅人肯记下的一本护照，他说这一遍才是那个日子的全部。（check the passport）
那本护照，指的是那本护照本身而不是小小的地图，经过了三个日子而在簿子上没有被记下。（passport）
那处山谷里每一本护照旁边都有同一张小小的地图。（passport）
最远那处崖台那本护照，指的是他们留给孩子们找的那一处，是唯一有人谢过两次的。（passport）
叔叔说这本行止就是那件事的全部，指的是那样东西而不是那本护照。（passport）
1963 年母亲说，护照是唯一会因为被好好记下而变得更好的护照。（passport）
answers: In 1954 the guide checked the passport that no traveller in the valley would have noted, and he said the checking was the whole of the day.
The passport, meaning the document itself and not the map, ran three days and stayed unnoted in the book.
Every passport in that valley had the same short map beside it.
The passport at the far ledge, meaning the mark they kept for the children to find and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice.
My uncle said the passport was the whole of the matter, meaning the freedom and not the document.
A passport, my mother said in 1963, is the only document that improves by being noted.
